youtube.title: What If You Could Hear Everyone's Thoughts?
tags: what if you could hear everyone's thoughts
youtube.intro: One Monday morning, you wake up and you can hear what everyone is thinking. Your mum, your best friend, the bus driver, the whole school. Nobody can hear yours. At first it's the best game in the world. Then the noise never stops, and one new girl's head is perfectly silent.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you keep the power, or take Nora's offer of silence? 👇

And why did Nora give it to YOU? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The real parts check out: people have about 6,000 thoughts a day, our minds wander almost half the time, 6 in 10 people lie in a 10-minute chat with a stranger, and brain implants have started to decode inner speech. Sources are in the description.

🔔 Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2: what happens when she takes it back?
